camera-extrinsic-calibration.description: Extrinsic calibration service providing 4x4 homogeneous transforms between camera frames and robot base frame for 3D coordinate conversion.

grounded-sam2.description: Open-vocabulary object detection and segmentation using Grounding DINO + SAM 2. Accepts image + text prompt, returns bounding boxes, masks, and confidence scores.

graspgen.description: 6-DOF grasp pose generation using Contact-GraspNet. Accepts depth image or point cloud, returns ranked grasp poses as 4x4 homogeneous transforms with quality scores.

foundation-stereo.description: High-quality stereo depth estimation using FoundationStereo. Accepts rectified stereo image pairs, returns dense disparity and metric depth maps.

lightweight-grasp-net.description: Real-time RGB-D grasp detection using GR-ConvNet v2. Fast inference (<50ms) for closed-loop grasping. Returns ranked grasp candidates with position, angle, width, quality.

raw-depth-sdk.description: Raw depth frame access SDK. Provides depth images as numpy arrays from RealSense cameras via SDK methods, bypassing HTTP import restrictions in the sandbox.

nav-mapping-service.description: Navigation and occupancy mapping service. Maintains 2D occupancy grid, provides path planning (A*/RRT*), frontier exploration, and map persistence.

realsense-slam.description: RealSense visual SLAM using RTAB-Map. Real-time 6-DOF pose estimation, incremental 3D mapping, loop closure, map save/load for persistent localization.

local-obstacle-avoidance.description: Real-time local obstacle avoidance for mobile base using depth camera. VFH-based safe velocity, emergency stop.
